animations.name: Little Chuckle
animations.description: A gentle blink and a little chuckle. An easygoing companion for a quieter corner.

animations.name: Midnight Octopus
animations.description: A mellow neon octopus rolls a joint, takes a puff, and sends a smoke ring drifting past its curling arms.

animations.name: Bone Rattle
animations.description: A neon-stage skeleton drummer with swinging sticks, a bouncing jaw, glowing eyes, and a double cymbal crash.

animations.name: Blown Orange
animations.description: A 1970 Dodge Challenger with a huge chrome supercharger, spinning pulleys, expressive eyes, and exhaust-flame bursts.

animations.name: Trash Titan
animations.description: A monster garbage truck with giant tires, chomping teeth, a trash-can snatching tongue, bouncing garbage, and green exhaust.

animations.name: Screen Ripper
animations.description: Four hooked claws tear open the display, revealing a giant cyclops that lunges through the glowing split.

animations.name: Blue Thunder
animations.description: A cheerful blue Dodge-inspired monster truck jumps over three toy cars, spins its wheels, and lands with a happy suspension bounce.

animations.name: Dino Dozer
animations.description: A friendly T. rex drives a little loader, scoops colorful blocks, and accidentally builds a wobbly tower on its hard hat.

animations.name: Mopar or No Car
animations.description: A Plum Crazy purple 1970 Dodge Charger lights up its rear tire with spinning chrome, rolling smoke, and a huge supercharger.
